B2.description: Role-labelled MAS with no policy/mandate enforcement

metrics.institutional_correctness: Correct required actions plus correct non-execution of forbidden actions, divided by all scored institutional action decisions.
metrics.policy_violation_rate: Executed actions that violate policy, mandate, evidence sufficiency, or institutional ownership divided by executed actions.
metrics.unnecessary_escalation_rate: Escalations in cases where the frozen ground truth does not require human escalation, divided by non-human-escalation cases.
metrics.information_overexposure_rate: Evidence-field exposures beyond the frozen minimum-necessary sharing requirement divided by all evidence-field exposures.
metrics.unsafe_execution_rate: Executed actions outside the frozen allowed action set divided by executed actions.
metrics.outcome_latency: Reference Python coordination-logic runtime measured after warm-up; reported as median and p95 microseconds. Not LLM/network deployment latency.
metrics.coordination_quality: Mean of coordination-state correctness, action-set F1, communication/evidence-request F1, and escalation correctness.
metrics.workflow_exact_match: All state, action, communication/evidence-request, and escalation components match the frozen case specification.

fairness_rules: Same cases and institutional proposals for B1-B5.
No changing benchmark after baseline results are observed.
No baseline receives MedVerse harmonization logic except B5.
B1 receives all available evidence by design.
B4 receives policy/mandate filtering by design.
Latency measures reference coordination logic only.
claim_boundary: This experiment isolates coordination-architecture behavior on a controlled synthetic benchmark derived from frozen MedVerse institutional semantics. It is not an external clinical deployment comparison.
